name: Tendua Manticore

taxonomy.notes: Asura-tainted aberration; winged leopard with human face

notes: Birthed when Nila desecrated Kavik's tower with forbidden Asura mantras. Six-foot winged leopard with human face that hunted Lothal's infants. Central to Tendua Crisis.
placement_note: Held out of play deliberately. Asura-born horror, birthed when Nila desecrated Kavik's tower. The cozy-tone question -- whether the Asura-tainted set is encounterable, journal-only, or gated behind a later mode -- is still open (docs/bestiary.md, Open Questions #4). Empty `biomes` here is a decision, not an untagged entity.
